subject: BridgeBank: DPIA onboarding - evidence batch & timeline
messages:
From: Emma Stein <emma.stein@bridgebank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: it.audit@bridgebank.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 15:06:42 +0200
Subject: DPIA onboarding - initial evidence request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As part of our onboarding checklist we need a short evidence package to feed into our DPIA and internal audit. Can you confirm the following by EOD next Wednesday (2025-07-23):

1) A completed copy of your standard DPIA questionnaire (or your answers to our attached questionnaire).
2) An Art.30 processing ledger excerpt showing categories of processing, recipients, and retention for the features BridgeBank will use (text generation + embeddings).
3) Subprocessor inventory as of today with country and transfer mechanism (SCCs, adequacy, or on-prem).

Also, please flag any high-risk data flows (PII, banking identifiers) and whether you require a separate DPA appendix for encrypted on-prem deployments. Our audit team (cc'd) may follow up with a short set of clarifying questions.

Appreciate a single zip/batch if possible — reduces our intake work.

Best,
Emma Stein
Head of Vendor Risk | BridgeBank

Attachments: bridgebank_dpia_questionnaire_v1.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Stein <emma.stein@bridgebank.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, it.audit@bridgebank.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 17:02:11 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA onboarding - initial evidence request

Emma — thanks for the clear list. Confirming we can provide the items you listed. Quick notes before we assemble:

- We'll return the filled questionnaire (completed copy) and a CSV snapshot of the subprocessor inventory. The inventory will include subprocessors, their country, and whether transfers rely on SCCs/adequacy.
- The Art.30 ledger will be an excerpt focused on the BridgeBank scope (text gen, embeddings) and will include lawful basis, purposes, categories of data, retention periods, and recipients.
- For high-risk flows: by default our hosted offering can process bank identifiers if customers supply them in prompts; we treat these as special categories in the ledger and annotate whether they are redacted in telemetry. For any processing BridgeBank wants to keep on-prem, we can propose a DPA appendix and operational separation — that would be a separate contractual addendum.

Timeline we propose: deliver a single evidence bundle on Tue 2025-07-22 17:00 UTC, which gives your team a day to review before your EOD 07-23 target. Is that acceptable?

I'll attach a short cover note explaining the inventory columns and a mapping to Art.28/30. Priyom and Marissa are on the thread for evidence assembly; Karthik will validate controls language for SCCs and any transfer notes.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_readme.txt (stub)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Emma Stein <emma.stein@bridgebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, it.audit@bridgebank.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:34:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA onboarding - initial evidence request

Following up with the delivery plan and what will be in the bundle:

- bridgebank_dpia_questionnaire_v1.xlsx: completed answers, plus link to our public privacy policy and DPA clauses referenced in Q12–Q15.
- processing_ledger_art30_excerpt.pdf: 3 pages, BridgeBank scope only, redactions applied to unrelated customers. Ledger includes: processing activity id, purpose, categories of personal data (e.g., prompt text, user metadata, session ids), recipients (including subs), retention.
- subprocessor_inventory_2025-07.csv: columns = {name, function, country, transfer_mechanism, last_audit_date, SOC2_status}.
- controls_readout.txt: short bullets on encryption in transit/at-rest, KMS integrations, pseudonymization options, and our logging retention policy.

Note on transfers: most subprocessors are US-based infra providers; transfers rely on EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and our DPA includes Art.28 obligations. For customers requesting data locality we offer Dedicated VPC or Private deployment; if BridgeBank needs a dedicated appendix, please share the template and we'll slot the language.

We'll upload the bundle to the shared Drive link and email you the link + one-time download token. Expected upload window: Tue 2025-07-22 11:00–13:00 UTC.

-Priyom
Head of Evidence Operations (Redwood Inference)

Attachments: subprocessor_inventory_2025-07.csv (stub), processing_ledger_art30_excerpt.pdf (stub)

From: Emma Stein <emma.stein@bridgebank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: it.audit@bridgebank.com, legal@bridgebank.com, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 10:45:00 +0200
Subject: Re: DPIA onboarding - initial evidence request

Team — thanks, that timeline works and the level of detail looks good. One small ask from Audit: can you call out any subprocessors that perform Model Training/Weight Updates (not inference) separately in the inventory, and explicitly confirm whether any analytics telemetry is retained beyond 90 days by default?

If you can add a single CSV column for 'training_activity' (yes/no) and one for 'telemetry_retention_days' we'll be able to ingest automatically. Also, legal asked for the exact SCC version cited in your DPA (e.g., Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/914).

Once we have the bundle we'll run it through our DPIA tool and ping with any follow-ups. Appreciate the quick turn.

Emma
Head of Vendor Risk | BridgeBank
